title: Johnny Test (New)
description: How much trouble could one imaginative boy, his faithful dog and two science-loving sisters possibly get into? Hmm, that sounds like a challenge!

episodes.title: S2-E1Johnny's Got a Brand New Mom
S2-E6The Revenge of Johnny's Baby Bro
S2-E11Return to the Wizard of Johnny

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x1
episodes_data.description: Tired of losing in the game “Melee Island,” Bling Bling transports Johnny Test and the rest of the crew to a real island to show off his combat skills.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x2
episodes_data.description: Susan and Mary create an adorable robot baby brother that seems to have just one thing on its mind: mass destruction.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x3
episodes_data.description: Susan and Mary perform a wee bit of brain surgery on Johnny to re-calibrate his feelings about eating vegetables.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x4
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey sneak into an Enormazon warehouse. Meanwhile, Susan and Mary suspect their household's digital assistant of something sinister.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x5
episodes_data.description: After Johnny is silenced by the town librarian for making too much noise, his sisters and Dukey set out to give him his voice back.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x6
episodes_data.description: A new monster-hunting mobile game is a hit with everyone in town... until the creatures cross over into the real world and threaten to take over.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x7
episodes_data.description: To help Johnny avoid having to go to summer school, Susan, Mary and Dukey shrink themselves and enter his brain to boost his memory.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x8
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey try to help down-on-his-luck movie star Speed McCool while Susan and Mary strive to create the perfect microwave popcorn.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x9
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey challenge each other to spend one night in the newly created — and ultra-spooky — backyard forest.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x10
episodes_data.description: Eager to meet a rollercoaster's height requirement, Johnny asks his twin sisters to make him taller. And they do — sort of.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x11
episodes_data.description: In an effort to get Johnny excited for a family vacation, Susan and Mary decide to show him ancient Rome, up close and personal.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x12
episodes_data.description: Things get weird fast when Johnny attempts to throw a modest music festival in his own backyard.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x13
episodes_data.description: When Susan and Mary create a new face-swapping invention, Johnny and Dukey are more than happy to test it out.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x14
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey sell Susan and Mary's stuff at a yard sale, not knowing the so-called "junk" is actually a pile of very powerful weaponry.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x15
episodes_data.description: After disrupting Susan, Mary and Dukey's spa day, Johnny finds himself stuck in an unremovable face mask and gets mistaken for a luchador.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x16
episodes_data.description: Johnny's mom has scheduled a famous photographer to take a family portrait, but Susan and Mary's hair isn't in the mood to cooperate.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x17
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey, Susan and Mary, Bling Bling and many more set out to solve a booby-trapped corn maze in hopes of winning a sweet prize.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x18
episodes_data.description: Mr. White and Mr. Black are given a time-sensitive mission, but there's a problem involving sheep, experiments, and — of course — Johnny Test.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x19
episodes_data.description: Bored with life in his hometown, Johnny asks his inventor sisters to get him out of Porkbelly — a wish they're more than happy to grant.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 1x20
episodes_data.description: With Christmas around the corner, the Test family tries to out-do their neighbors' irritatingly impressive holiday light display.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x1
episodes_data.description: When Johnny gets in trouble at school, he asks his sisters to develop a robot mom that looks just like the real thing to trick his teacher.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x2
episodes_data.description: Bling Bling forces Johnny, Dukey, Susan, Mary and many others to return to Melee Island for another over-the-top battle royale.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x3
episodes_data.description: Johnny sets out to prove a popular series of wizarding books is overrated and needlessly long by becoming a wizard in virtual reality.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x4
episodes_data.description: Desperate to avoid embarrassment on the basketball court, Johnny uses his sisters' latest invention: the world's first fully functional good luck charm.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x5
episodes_data.description: After suffering nightmares about the Big Bad Wolf, Johnny decides to face his fears in Susan and Mary’s dream chamber invention.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x6
episodes_data.description: Ten-hut! Johnny’s nefarious baby-brother-bot escapes from military school to cause more chaos among the Test family.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x7
episodes_data.description: After Bling Bling pleads for help with a genetically altered crab, Johnny and Dukey decide that even their biggest rival deserves a claw — er, a hand.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x8
episodes_data.description: It's family game night in the Test household, and Johnny wants his parents and sisters to take the escape room trend to a whole new level.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x9
episodes_data.description: After someone — or something — destroys a candy store, Mr. Black and Mr. White call on Johnny X to handle the fallout.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x10
episodes_data.description: When Johnny gets locked out of his video game, Mary and Susan send him into Tiny'mon's virtual world in hopes of getting some answers.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x11
episodes_data.description: After devouring a chapter of a yet-to-be-released Wizard Lad novel, Susan and Mary must know what happens next — and it’s up to Johnny to find out.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x12
episodes_data.description: Johnny enlists Dukey to star in a series of hilarious online videos for Snoob-Tube in hopes of making some serious money,

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x13
episodes_data.description: Johnny loves it. Dad and Dukey do not. The members of the Test family have strong opinions about Susan and Mary’s new smart home upgrade.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x14
episodes_data.description: Johnny embarks on a quest to complete his Squishy Wooshie collection by nabbing a Gnarly Narwhal from a stubborn vending machine at the car wash.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x15
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey each uncover a dinosaur fossil then set out to see whose dinosaur would win a fight by bringing them both back to life.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x16
episodes_data.description: How can there be a Johnny X Con without the real Johnny even being invited? Fear not! That’s exactly what our intrepid hero intends to find out.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x17
episodes_data.description: When Johnny’s beloved video game console catches on fire, he sets out to win a limited edition version at a restaurant filled with creepy animatronics.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x18
episodes_data.description: Dad buys the car of his dreams and forbids Johnny from driving, touching or even looking at it. If only there were a way around these rules...

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x19
episodes_data.description: Johnny and Dukey get a surprise visit from their future selves, who have an important message about how to save Porkbelly.

episodes_data.title: Johnny Test (New) 2x20
episodes_data.description: When the action figures Johnny is obsessing over are quickly sold out, he decides to make his own using his sisters' 3D printer.
